propositions: Eleven ambient config/credential reads across 9 files (_logging, _opcert_signing, _operation_config, mirror_guard, review_bot/app, signing, grounding/harness, grounding/oracle, grounding/resolve) currently sit below the approved composition/credential/backend seams and must be routed through them.

Each below-seam read must be classified as either cut-to-seam (threaded from OperationSnapshot or startup binding) or register-owned (annotated with inline `# read-via: <reason>` marker for kill-switch/test-only controls).
The corresponding LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS entries for these 9 files must be removed from scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py once reads are cut or annotated.
After cutover, `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` must report zero findings for these 9 paths with no exceptions remaining and no path-glob fallback.
The subsystem behavioral suites (signing, opcert, logging, grounding) must pass with redacted operation-snapshot fingerprints unchanged except for recorded approved deltas.
